lines.en: I walk on with a tool over my shoulder
A wrench swings in my hand

lines.zh: 工作服上的油早就烧干了
lines.en: The oil on my coveralls burned dry long ago
I follow the pipes forward
I tread on iron plate, a dull sound

lines.zh: 我的手套磨破了几个指头
lines.en: My gloves are worn through at the fingers

lines.zh: 我弯腰穿过一道低矮的管廊
lines.en: I duck through a low pipe run

lines.zh: 我一边走一边把阀门拧紧
lines.en: I tighten a valve as I walk

lines.zh: 火光把我的工具照得发亮
lines.en: The firelight shines on my tools
I pause half a beat, then step on

lines.zh: 我把一段废管拖在身后
lines.en: I drag a length of scrap pipe behind me

lines.zh: 我的脚步和管道的滴声对上了
lines.en: My steps match the drip of the pipes

lines.zh: 我坐在地上拧一颗螺栓
lines.en: I sit on the ground turning a bolt
Tools are spread at my feet

lines.zh: 我看着自己烧坏的手背
lines.en: I look at the burned back of my hand
I listen to the pressure in the pipes
I flip the wrench over

lines.zh: 这具身体还在按老习惯动
lines.en: This body still moves by old habits
I sit by the pipe mouth, staring

lines.zh: 我的呼吸里带着铁锈味
lines.en: My breath smells of rust

lines.zh: 我在想还有哪一段没修
lines.en: I wonder which section is still unrepaired

lines.zh: 我把工具一件件摆整齐
lines.en: I line the tools up one by one
You have no work badge
This is the equipment zone
Your boots are not regulation
I look up from behind the pipes
My work is not finished

lines.zh: 你站的位置挡住了管线
lines.en: You are standing on the pipeline
I cannot recall your face
You should not be above ground

lines.zh: 我的眼睛被烟熏过，看不远
lines.en: Smoke has dimmed my eyes, I cannot see far
Is that a tool in your hand
My shoulder took a blow
Blood mixes with oil and runs down

lines.zh: 这身工作服又破了一处
lines.en: My coveralls tore in another place

lines.zh: 我咬着牙把工具换到另一只手
lines.en: I grit my teeth and switch the tool to my other hand
I retreat behind the pipes
This body can still hold out

lines.zh: 我按住伤口，手上全是铁锈
lines.en: I press the wound, my hand all rust

lines.zh: 这点伤我在工地上见多了
lines.en: I saw worse on the site
I take one breath before I steady myself
The tool in hand must not be dropped
I do not eat any of this
What are you lifting that for
My work meal ended long ago
This cannot fix a pipe

lines.zh: 我低头看了一眼就移开视线
lines.en: I glance down and look away
My hand keeps turning the bolt
Put it down
I have a whole run of pipe to replace
This does not affect my work
This body has no appetite
You knocked over my toolbox
I bend down and gather the tools

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，铁器叮当
lines.en: We collided, iron clattering
You stepped on my wrench
I shoulder you aside

lines.zh: 我退开，先护住手里的东西
lines.en: I back off, shielding what I hold
This collision is not an incident
I line the tools up again

lines.zh: 你的力气让你看起来不太像工人
lines.en: Your strength makes you look unlike a worker
Do not touch my pipes

lines.zh: 这种事不在工作手册里
lines.en: That is not in the work manual

lines.zh: 我这副身体早就换了用途
lines.en: This body has long had another use
I am still on this shift
You should ask the foreman
My hands are all grease

lines.zh: 工牌上的字我认不全了
lines.en: I can barely read the name on my badge
I go back to turning my bolt
There is no work order for this topic

lines.zh: 我摇摇头，扳手又转起来
lines.en: I shake my head, the wrench turns again
I lower my head to my chest
I pick up a dropped bolt
This one can still be tightened

lines.zh: 我把它放进胸前的口袋
lines.en: I put it in my chest pocket
Every fallen part must be collected
I pick up a washer
This is the wrong size
I wipe the dust off on my sleeve
Inventory is one short again
I hook it onto my belt buckle
I look at it and put it back
Something is by the pipeline
First I put down my work
It carries no work badge
I tighten my grip on the wrench
This run of pipe cannot break
I start walking that way
My steps are heavier than usual
No foreman's whistle sounded
I will deal with it
Do not touch my equipment
That shadow moved

lines.zh: 我把它记在待修清单上
lines.en: I put it on the repair list

lines.zh: 我先把危险的那根管子关掉
lines.en: First I shut off the dangerous pipe
I grab the nearest tool
I work along the ground step by step
It stepped on my pipeline

lines.zh: 我的手指在扳手上收紧
lines.en: My fingers tighten on the wrench
I measure the distance along the pipes
This area is mine to maintain
I do not call for help, there is no one left

lines.zh: 我在找一个能下手的角度
lines.en: I look for an angle to strike

lines.zh: 它动一下，我的工具就抬一下
lines.en: It moves, and my tool lifts
Two blocks closer will do
The wrench is already over my shoulder
I work my way around the piping
It is too close to the valve

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在头盔里回响
lines.en: My breathing echoes in my helmet
I crouch and look at it from low down

lines.zh: 这段通道很窄，它跑不开
lines.en: This passage is narrow, it cannot flee

lines.zh: 我把工具换成了重的那把
lines.en: I switch to the heavy tool
The wrench comes down on its shoulder
I brace it back with the tool handle

lines.zh: 这一下用了十几年的力气
lines.en: This blow used decades of strength

lines.zh: 我把它的手压到管线上
lines.en: I pin its hand against the pipe

lines.zh: 我的手套磨破了，抓得很实
lines.en: My glove is worn, but my grip is firm
It retreats, I raise the wrench again
It is not elegant, but it is heavy
I push it away from the equipment

lines.zh: 我用工具撬了它的关节
lines.en: I pry at its joint with the tool
I shove it into the pipes
I bring the tool down on its knee

lines.zh: 我用肩膀把它挤出通道
lines.en: I shoulder it out of the passage
This one lands in the armor gap

lines.zh: 我抓着它的衣领往管壁上撞
lines.en: I grab its collar and slam it into the pipe wall
My swing is clumsy but solid
I let go and it drops away
I straighten up from behind the pipes

lines.zh: 这身工作服还是原来的
lines.en: These coveralls are the old ones
My badge still hangs at my neck
Argent flows in my veins

lines.zh: 这里有一段管线需要修
lines.en: There is a run of pipe here to fix

lines.zh: 下界的温度不适合施工
lines.en: The Nether's heat is unfit for work
I set my toolbox by my feet
I am still that worker

lines.zh: 只是不记得给谁干活了
lines.en: I just do not remember who for
I pick the wrench up

lines.zh: 工具箱还在，我就能干活
lines.en: The toolbox is here, so I can work
First I check the valves

lines.zh: 火苗顺着工作服往上爬
lines.en: Flames climb my coveralls
I fell from the pipe run

lines.zh: 水或者别的液体灌进了我的嘴
lines.en: Water or something else filled my mouth

lines.zh: 爆炸把整段管线都炸断了
lines.en: The blast severed the whole pipe run

lines.zh: 飞来的东西打在我的工具箱上
lines.en: Something flying hit my toolbox

lines.zh: 那股术力顺着工具手柄上来
lines.en: That magic climbed the tool handle

lines.zh: 我早就忘了工餐的时间
lines.en: I forgot the meal break long ago

lines.zh: 雷打在铁管上，电流穿过我
lines.en: Lightning struck the iron pipe and the current ran through me
The iron plate beneath me is gone
